title: Emmere y'Omukadde gy'atasuubira
intro: Mu bifo ebitukuvu eby’Ennyumba ya Allah, omuweereza wa Katonda omukadde yafuna ekyama ekinene ennyo ekyasomooza byonna bye baali basuubira. Omuntu ono eyeewaddeyo, eyali ayise edda emyaka egy’obuzadde obw’obutonde, yalaba ekintu eky’enjawulo ekyabikkula okusaasira okutaliiko kkomo okw’Obwakatonda. Ekizibu kiri mu kubikkula akaseera kano akeerabirwa okuva mu bulamu bwa bannabbi.
clues: Abantu bange baali bamanyiddwa nga Isiraeri, bazzukulu ba jjajja omukulu ow’edda.
Namala ekiro kyange mu kusaba, nga nvunnama mu maaso ga Mukama wange mu yeekaalu.
Naweebwa omwana ow’obulenzi mu bukadde bwange, ekirabo kye silekera awo kugulumiza Allah.
Okugezesebwa kwange kwali kuzingiramu okuzuula eky’okweyimirizaawo ekyalabika eri emmeeme ento eyali wansi w’okulabirira kwange.
Nnali nnabbi ayitibwa Zakariyya, eyaweebwa omulimu gw’okulabirira Maryam mu Bayt al-Maqdis.
Eky’okuddamu kiri mu aya Allah mwe yakkiriza Maryam n’amufunira eby’okulya.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
